title: Director, Assistant General Counsel - Litigation
descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Build the future of data. Join the Snowflake team.

We are looking for an experienced attorney to join Snowflake's Legal team as Director, Assistant General Counsel - Litigation. In this role, you will manage a diverse portfolio of litigation matters, serve as a trusted partner and advisor to the business, leverage artificial intelligence to enhance the way we get work done, and supervise one in-house litigation counsel. This role will report to Snowflake’s Senior Director, Associate General Counsel - Employment & Litigation. This is an in-person role based in Menlo Park, CA or Atlanta, GA. This is not a remote position.

Responsibilities

Litigation Management and Advising

  • Working collaboratively with our Legal team, outside counsel, and cross-functional stakeholders, manage disputes and litigation matters across their full lifecycle — from initial case assessment through resolution.

  • Lead and manage internal investigations on matters involving legal risks to Snowflake, including coordinating with the People team, Security organization, and other relevant functions.

  • Manage and coordinate responses to subpoenas, garnishment orders, domestic relations orders, statutory requests for information, and requests from government and law enforcement agencies.

  • Review and advise on litigation-related contractual provisions in commercial agreements, including dispute resolution, governing law, venue, arbitration, limitation of liability, and indemnification clauses.

  • Advise business stakeholders on litigation risks and issues involved in business disputes; pragmatically weigh legal risks and benefits of complex situations and propose practical, business-oriented solutions with tact and maturity.

  • Manage outside counsel relationships, including matter staffing, billing review, and strategic direction of litigation.

  • Partner with privacy counsel and other specialists on disputes involving data, security, or regulatory matters.

Process & Infrastructure

  • Lead efforts to create, improve, and scale processes and procedures related to the handling of litigation matters for a rapidly growing, global company, including litigation hold protocols, matter tracking, reporting, and knowledge management.

  • Partner with legal operations on litigation-related technology, data, and workflow improvements.

  • Develop and maintain internal resources, templates, and playbooks to support consistent and efficient litigation management.

Requirements

  • JD from an accredited law school, active membership in at least one state bar, and ability to practice in the jurisdiction in which this position is located.

  • Minimum of 8 years of legal experience, with substantive in-house litigation management and law firm experience; people management experience a plus.

  • Proven experience managing complex litigation matters; class action experience a plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage outside counsel, control litigation budgets, and set case strategy.

  • Experience conducting and coordinating internal investigations.

  • Experience managing responses to subpoenas and government/law enforcement inquiries.

  • Ability to explain complicated legal concepts in plain language.

  • Strong organizational skills, exceptional judgment, and comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Fosters team collaboration through high-quality work, a positive attitude, and clear, solution-focused communication.


Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
